query:
SELECT ua.id, ua.appUserId, ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.description, ua.createdAt, au.name, au.email
FROM user_actions ua
LEFT JOIN app_users au ON ua.appUserId = au.id
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
